PowerOneLineThree: still use this to have your group disappear into cyberspace
PowerOneLineFour: provided you have a network to target.

PowerTwoLineTwo: has both circumstantial or mystical buffs.
PowerThreeLineOne: You can place a mutually untraceable phone-call to anyone whose name

PowerThreeLineThree: will be compelled to answer. This works even if the phone has no
PowerFourLineOne: Whereever you currently are, you can ground yourself in the nearest point
PowerFourLineTwo: of cyberspace that sees regular Tamer activity. This lets you quickly warp
PowerFourLineThree: between worlds. If you're in Cyberspace the target world switches to Earth.
